info.name: x402-agentic-text-pipeline
info.description: A multi-tier token-slashing text utility hub engineered for autonomous AI developer agents. Provides structural data ingestion, text compression, financial sentiment indexing, and multilingual translation layers wrapped in onchain x402 monetization gates.

tools.name: web_scraper
tools.description: Strips heavy layout components, frames, and styling from any raw HTML webpage link and extracts clean, markdown-optimized string content built for rapid LLM token ingestion.

url.description: The target website URL destination to scrape.

tools.name: text_summarizer
tools.description: Compresses massive unstructured text documents and heavy log files down into brief, core sentence snapshots to dramatically cut down context window token weights.

text.description: The raw input text to shorten.

tools.name: crypto_sentiment_analyzer
tools.description: Performs programmatic keywords velocity indexing over textual string inputs to output calculated market momentum indices (BULLISH, BEARISH, or NEUTRAL).

text.description: The market updates, news snippets, or social text data arrays to analyze.

tools.name: multilingual_translator
tools.description: Translates text streams natively into dynamic localized regional idioms (e.g. es, fr, de) optimized to normalize foreign web scrapes before processing loops.

text.description: The source text block payload to translate.

target_lang.description: The target ISO language code (e.g., 'es' for Spanish, 'fr' for French).
